description: Figure 3, titled "Results of different logical synthesis modules on BIRD-dev," is a bar chart that compares the performance of two different logical synthesis modules: the TALOG module and the NatLOG module. The chart displays results across three evaluation metrics: Recall, Precision, and F1 Score, which are shown on the horizontal axis. The vertical axis represents the performance score, ranging from 0 to 100. For each metric, there are two bars: a light blue bar representing the TALOG module and a green bar representing the NatLOG module. The TALOG module consistently outperforms the NatLOG module across all three metrics. Specifically, the TALOG module achieves a Recall of 88.89, a Precision of 91.24, and an F1 Score of 80.40. In contrast, the NatLOG module achieves a Recall of 81.08, a Precision of 92.31, and an F1 Score of 75.34. The chart visually demonstrates that the TALOG module exhibits superior performance across various levels of difficulty compared to the NatLOG module.
